content.comment_body: Hello everyone, According to the manual, the programming cable for PC USB with article number [article_no] is needed for versions up to [version_no]. For later versions (such as [version_no]), programming can be done through an Ethernet cable. Is this correct? Best regards, [user_name]
The PC USB cable is required for all [product_name] versions from [version_no] up to [version_no]. For [product_name] with [version_no] or above, you can use an Ethernet cable instead.
Don’t forget about the RS232 cable; I still have some of those around.
Why do you think I forgot about it? The question was specifically about the USB cable. I personally have an RS232 cable paired with a USB/RS232 converter, as well as a USB cable.
